# PrepBuddy

> 1-on-1 mentorship for India's JEE (Main + Advanced) and NEET UG aspirants. Every student is paired with a dedicated topper-mentor — an IITian for JEE, an AIIMS or top medical-college student for NEET — who builds a personalized study plan from real mock scores and runs daily accountability check-ins.

PrepBuddy is not a coaching institute. It does not teach syllabus content, run batches, or replace NCERT/coaching. It replaces the missing layer between content and results: a mentor who plans your week, watches your mocks, catches recurring errors, and keeps you consistent. Students typically use PrepBuddy alongside their existing self-study or coaching.

## Core facts

- Audience: Class 11, Class 12, and Droppers preparing for JEE or NEET UG in India.
- Mentors: JEE mentors are IITians; NEET mentors are AIIMS or top medical-college students. Every mentor passes a 4-stage selection (application, subject screener, mock mentoring session, final interview).
- Format: 1-on-1 (never batches). Daily short check-ins + one deeper weekly review call. Plans are rebuilt weekly from the student's real mock scores.
- Base: Hyderabad, India. Mentorship is delivered fully online, nationwide.
- Scale: 150+ students mentored to date.
- Contact: hello@prepbuddy.co

## Pricing (INR)

- 3-day trial: ₹99. One mentor call, a personalized 3-day plan built from the last mock, daily check-ins.
- 1-hour 1:1 session: ₹999. Second-opinion / one-topic strategy call, no ongoing plan required.
- 1 month mentorship: ₹1,599.
- 3 months mentorship: ₹3,999.
- 6 months mentorship: ₹5,999.
- Refunds and cancellation: none. All purchases are final — plans, the ₹99 trial and the ₹999 session are non-refundable, and plans cannot be cancelled part-way through.
- Pausing: plans of 3 months and above can be paused once, for up to 15 days in total. The 1 month plan, the trial and the single session cannot be paused.
- Mentor re-match: free and available at any point in a plan if the mentor fit isn't right.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): overview of PrepBuddy, exam selector for JEE / NEET.
- [JEE Mentorship](/jee): mentorship for JEE Main + Advanced, IITian mentors, JEE-specific FAQs and plans.
- [NEET Mentorship](/neet): mentorship for NEET UG, AIIMS / medical-college mentors, NEET-specific FAQs and plans.
- [Become a Mentor](/become-a-mentor): application page for IITians and AIIMS/medical students who want to mentor.
- [Contact](/contact): WhatsApp, email, contact form.
- [Resources](/resources): free JEE and NEET preparation guides written by mentors — mock analysis, dropper strategy, revision planning.
- [Free Guidance Preview](/guidance-preview): a 2-minute questionnaire that returns the pattern a mentor would spot in a first call. No signup, no score, no rank prediction.

## Policies

- [Trust & Safety](/trust-and-safety): mentor verification (4-stage), conduct rules, and safeguarding for minors.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): what we collect and how to have it removed. No advertising trackers; data is never sold.
- [Terms](/terms): no rank, score or admission is guaranteed. Any results shown are individual past outcomes.
